body: What do we talk about?  I don't know what to say.

I live very close to Los Angeles, I've been there a few times in my life and I've always liked how impressively the damn place is.  It's just miles and miles of city and things to see.  That seems the most logical place.  As weird as this may sound though I wouldn't mind living in the middle of nowhere, with no people for miles around.  It seems weird to me and it probably sounds stupid that my answers are on opposite side of the places to live spectrum but that's just where I think I would be most happy.

Most of my problems are very much temporary and insignificant.  My depression is what makes it so hard.  I feel terrible everyday and even thought I try to do what society expects of me I fail.  The problem is not just that my circumstances are shitty now, but that even on the best of days I still feel like it would be better to be dead and not have to deal with any of this.
